rationale: C04 supplies unusually specific material reused in the child: the same Commission on Internal Security and Individual Rights, its inability to proceed without conflict-of-interest legislation from the Senate Judiciary Committee, the paired objectives of internal security and individual rights, and scrutiny of federal employee loyalty/security programs. The child converts that precise stalled-commission context into an interim NSC investigation. C22 is also strongly related because it establishes the Commission and expressly assigns it the employee security program, but C04 more directly supplies the child's immediate factual predicate and framing. C11 has a somewhat similar study-request form but lacks the distinctive subject matter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the work of that Commission has been delayed because of the failure of the Senate Committee on the Judiciary to report legislation which would exempt the members and staff of the Commission from the conflict-of-interest statutes
shared_material.parent_excerpt: request that the Senate Committee on the Judiciary give further consideration to H.R. 2829, to exempt the members and certain employees of the Commission on Internal Security and Individual Rights from the operation of certain conflict-of-interest statutes
shared_material.explanation: The child uses the precise legislative obstacle described in C04 as the reason for commissioning an interim study.

shared_material.child_excerpt: protecting the security of the Government without unduly infringing on the rights of individuals
shared_material.parent_excerpt: providing for the internal security of the United States and at the same time protecting the rights and freedoms of individuals
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the problem through the same distinctive balance between governmental security and individual rights.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the administration of the Government Employees Security Program
shared_material.parent_excerpt: One of the problems which the Commission was established to study is the operation of the Government's Employee Loyalty Program
shared_material.explanation: Both concern Commission review of federal employee screening programs, with the child shifting specifically to the security program and arranging preliminary review while the Commission is stalled.
